_comment: Accepted breaches of the platform client rules that drift.mjs checks (scripts/realm/drift.mjs). Only clients this repo does not manage belong here. Each entry is exact: anything not listed, including localhost or http redirects, still fails. Remove an entry when its client is tightened or retired (ocntechnology/ocn-keycloak#7).

cms.why: Constitution editor (public client, keycloak-js returns to the page the person was on). Whole-origin wildcards on OCN's own HTTPS hosts; tighten when the editor moves to a fixed callback.

cms-admin.why: Legacy editor admin client on OCN's own HTTPS host. Retire it once nothing signs in through it.
